# LangFn

> TypeScript SDK for model calls, tools, graphs, retrieval, observability, HTTP, and MCP.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](/docs/getting-started) — Create a TypeScript client and run a deterministic model call.
- [HTTP routes](/docs/http) — Mount model and trace endpoints with trusted authentication.
- [LangFn](/docs) — TypeScript SDK for model, tool, graph, retrieval, and evaluation workflows.
- [MCP integration](/docs/mcp) — Expose selected LangFn tools through McpFn.
- [Memory and RAG](/docs/memory-and-rag) — Choose in-process memory or injected retrieval adapters.
- [Models and providers](/docs/models-and-providers) — Select first-party capabilities and preserve provider messages.
- [Observability and evaluation](/docs/observability-and-evaluation) — Capture scoped traces, usage, feedback, and measured outcomes.
- [Operations and limits](/docs/operations-and-limits) — Source availability, release checks, and external proof boundaries.
- [Prompts and structured output](/docs/prompts-and-structured) — Format prompt templates and validate model output.
- [Provider compatibility](/docs/reference/compatibility) — First-party TypeScript provider capability matrix.
- [Reference](/docs/reference) — TypeScript package exports, provider matrix, and source release contract.
- [Package exports](/docs/reference/package-exports) — Public TypeScript subpaths in the current langfn manifest.
- [Release gate](/docs/reference/release-gate) — TypeScript build, test, package, and live-qualification boundaries.
- [TypeScript package](/docs/reference/typescript) — Current langfn TypeScript package guide.
- [Streaming and tools](/docs/streaming-and-tools) — Handle cancellation, tool policy, and network boundaries.
- [Workflows and agents](/docs/workflows) — Compose chains, parallel work, routers, state graphs, and agents.
